channel.title: NUUK — Market notes

item.title: 22 free signals, 12 never triggered: what our record shows
item.guid: 2026-11-25-22 free signals, 12 never triggered: what our record shows
item.description: Since 21 October: 6 targets, 4 stops and 12 entries never reached. A 60% hit rate on triggered signals and +5.15R in total. We publish the misses too.

item.title: A December Fed hike is priced in. The minutes explain why
item.guid: 2026-11-25-A December Fed hike is priced in. The minutes explain why
item.description: October payrolls came in at 165K against 65K expected and core CPI rose 0.3%. The minutes show some officials already wanted a hike, and Waller floated 50 bp.

item.title: Gold gives back $600 in two weeks
item.description: From $4,134 on 9 November to near $3,530: a stronger dollar and December hike bets pushed gold to 14-month lows. The levels the desk is watching now.

item.title: AUD: rate hikes cannot hold up a weakening economy
item.guid: 2026-11-25-AUD: rate hikes cannot hold up a weakening economy
item.description: The RBA lifted rates to 4.85% on a 6–3 vote. Then unemployment jumped to 4.9% and inflation hit 4.9%. The Aussie has lost 6.5% in a month.

item.title: Bitcoin near $59K: a hack, a hike and an AI selloff
item.guid: 2026-11-25-Bitcoin near $59K: a hack, a hike and an AI selloff
item.description: The month opened with a $6.3B Binance hack. Fed hike bets and the AI-stock selloff then took bitcoin to its lowest level in more than two years on 21 November.

item.title: September hikes: what a Fed move means for gold and the dollar
item.guid: 2026-09-07-September hikes: what a Fed move means for gold and the dollar
item.description: Markets price hikes from the Fed, RBA and BoJ this month. Where the surprise risk sits and how the desk positions ahead of CPI.

item.title: Gold at 4,400: the level that decides the next leg
item.guid: 2026-09-06-Gold at 4,400: the level that decides the next leg
item.description: Payrolls capped the bounce. Why 4,400 is the line between bulls and bears, and the two data prints that settle it.

item.title: AUD strength in 2026: carry, copper and the RBA
item.guid: 2026-09-04-AUD strength in 2026: carry, copper and the RBA
item.description: The Australian dollar is the strongest G10 currency this year. What is driving it and where the trade still has room.

item.title: Why our intraday ensemble stays in paper mode
item.guid: 2026-09-02-Why our intraday ensemble stays in paper mode
item.description: Hourly bars, retail costs, no edge. The walk-forward result behind the decision to keep intraday systems off live capital.
